narrationTexts: Confirms the bug in `orderTotal`: it taxes the pre-discount `cents` instead of the discounted amount.
finalText:
**Suite is green.** 625 total, 625 passing.

The bug was in `orderTotal` in `[src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41)`. It taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one, only showing up on rows where both discount and tax were non-zero.

Fixed by taxing `discounted` instead of `cents`. No other changes needed.
